behaviors.description: Enforce ordinary and conditional devel permissions through a real ptrace syscall.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed app/runtime and separately compiled libc probe exposed read-only.
behaviors.expected: The probe starts in every sandbox; explicit grants and true conditions permit ptrace, while revocation and false conditions deny it.

mappings.rationale: Live syscall outcomes verify devel permission enforcement independently of metadata reporting.

surface_assertions.rationale: Allowing devel permits the real ptrace syscall.
Disallowing devel rejects the syscall after a grant.
True and false devel conditions produce opposite ptrace outcomes.
